name: John Patton Ford
bio: John Patton Ford is an American screenwriter and film director. He is known for his 2022 debut feature Emily the Criminal, which starred Aubrey Plaza. The film premiered at the Sundance Film Festival, and Ford later received the Best First Screenplay Award at the 2023 Independent Spirits Awards.

credits.title: How to Make a Killing
credits.overview: Disowned at birth by his obscenely wealthy family, blue-collar Becket Redfellow will stop at nothing to reclaim his inheritance, no matter how many relatives stand in his way.

credits.title: Emily the Criminal
credits.overview: Desperate for income, Emily takes a shady gig buying goods with stolen credit cards supplied by a charismatic middleman named Youcef. Seduced by the quick cash and illicit thrills, they hatch a plan to take their business to the next level.

credits.title: Beautifully Esther
credits.overview: Esther's lifeless daily routine is interrupted when her husband suddenly collapses. Confronted with her husband's unwillingness to change, Esther must decide how she wants to spend the rest of her days.

credits.title: Patrol
credits.overview: Norm hates his gig as a security guard. He wanted a life of action, not a life of busting vandals at the mall. credits.overview: A parking lot security guard gives a Guatemalan boy a ride. Prejudice and compassion collide.

credits.title: He Can Hear It
credits.overview: A blind, retired musician has run into trouble keeping up with rent payments. His piano student shows up in a time of need.

credits.title: Ed Lee
credits.overview: A school janitor is not content with his job. Cleaning through the library, he discovers something important about himself.
